review_scope: Exact-hash incremental successor to v0.4. It adds two intended-only project workload bindings, two directly supported intended customer bindings, and explicit exclusions for the remaining modeled source-role candidates. Campus operating models and Saline campus capacities are never promoted to projects.

workload_scope_bindings.semantic_scope: The project-specific Stargate disclosure identifies the under-construction Saline campus as infrastructure being delivered for Oracle and OpenAI. This supports one intended ai_specialized_unspecified project workload only; it does not establish operational compute, a training-versus-inference split, installed accelerators, current users, utilization, or workload share.

role_bindings.semantic_scope: The project-specific disclosure says the under-construction campus is being delivered for Oracle and OpenAI. excluded_source_roles.semantic_scope: The Microsoft disclosure establishes ongoing construction of the second facility and distinguishes it from a first facility that is operational. The selected campus locator and campus-level hyperscaler classification add no project-role evidence.
excluded_source_roles.reason: The selected evidence does not explicitly assign current or intended operating responsibility for the unfinished second facility. Operation of the separate first facility and a campus operating model cannot be promoted to this project.

excluded_source_roles.semantic_scope: The Amazon page establishes an active buildout while separately saying Amazon already operates a campus at the location. The selected OSM building is a campus locator only, and the campus hyperscaler classification remains campus-scoped.
excluded_source_roles.reason: Existing campus operation does not separately establish current or intended operating responsibility for the unfinished active-buildout project. Neither the campus operating model nor the OSM operator tag may be promoted to the project.
